decision_rule: Do not continue PPO unless at least one recipe preserves M133 behavior and strict proof-surface diversity while avoiding worse fixed-batch outcome loss.
failure_criteria: all candidates keep behavior but regress strict selected seeds or pairs below M133
fixed-batch outcome loss improves only by a tiny amount while proof-surface diversity shrinks
candidate uses hidden or oracle actor inputs
hypothesis: M134 indicates ordinary guarded PPO can retain behavior but still shrink the outcome proof surface. A step-count and anchor-strength sensitivity gate should determine whether PPO can be made proof-surface preserving or should be deferred again.
success_criteria: at least one candidate matches or exceeds M133 behavior success
strict selected physical pairs and selected seeds meet or exceed M133 on both miner seeds
fixed-batch M128 outcome loss is not worse than M132 s60
candidate admission or PPO rejection is recorded explicitly
